column1: # The order make verify runs its steps in, and what each one costs (#2369).
#   group    rewrite: the steps that write the working tree, run first in this
#            order because every later step reads what they produce.
#            preamble: verify's serial steps before the lanes.
#            verify-go, verify-static, verify-docker, verify-ui: one lane each.
#   seconds  the step's measured wall clock when it runs. A diff-scoped step
#            costs a tenth of a second when the diff gives it nothing to do;
#            the figure here is its cost when it runs.
#   after    a step this one reads the output of, so it runs after that step
#            whatever it costs; "-" when it has none.
# Outside the rewrite group, the steps without an "after" run cheapest first,
# so the cheapest check that can fail fails first. TestVerifyRunsTheCheapestStepFirst
# (test/gates/verify_order_test.go) fails when the Makefile runs a step this
# table does not list, in a different order, or when a group here is out of
# ascending order. Each step prints "[step <name>: <seconds>s ok]" as it ends
# (scripts/verify-step.py); when a step's cost moves, update its figure here and
# move it to where the figure puts it.
# Measured 2026-10-29 on an 18-core machine, one step at a time, against the
# diff of PR #2370. test, test-realdb and release-check are their lanes'
# totals from that day's verify less the steps measured alone; each runs after
# a step it depends on, so its figure orders nothing.
